description: This file defines the BlockTokenParser class, a part of Twig's internal implementation for parsing template 'block' tags. It handles the parsing logic for reusable template sections, including block start, body, and end, integrating with Twig's node and token management system.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser lock
classes.description: Final class that parses the Twig 'block' tag, handling the extraction of block name, body content, and end tag recognition, ultimately producing a BlockReferenceNode for rendering.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'block' token, extracting its name and body, managing parser scopes, and returning a BlockReferenceNode.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Callback to determine if the current token marks the end of a block ('endblock').

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser ('block').
